messages:
alex: Hey team — I'll be out for the sprint retreat this weekend (Fri evening -> Mon morning). Need someone to take Saturday 09:00-17:00 oncall and shadow new hire Priya for a ramp. Runbook says single-owner for that window.

jess: I can take Sat daytime. Happy to pair with Priya for the day. :raised_hands:

samir: Thanks Jess. quick Q — is the db failover playbook updated for the newer replica set? If not, let's add a note for Priya.

oncall-bot: rota update: alex off 2026-03-28 18:00 -> 2026-03-31 09:00. Current open slot: Sat 09:00-17:00.

jess: Samir — good call. I'll add a short snippet in the handoff before 18:00. Can someone paste the exact `pg_replica_promote` command we use?

samir: it's `sudo -u postgres pg_ctl promote -D /var/lib/postgresql/13/main` — but we usually run the orchestration script: `scripts/promote-replica --env prod --id r2` (requires sudo).

maria: FYI there's a planned infra kernel upgrade Sat 22:00 that shouldn't affect daytime, but if a delayed reboot occurs it might. I'll put an alert in infra channel and leave contact details.

tyler: heads up — there's a canary rollout for the text-generation model Saturday 11:00-12:30. If latency spikes, fallback policy will route to smaller model; monitor `model-serving.latency.p95`.

alex: thanks all. Handoff checklist I'll post before I leave:
- account creds checked
- runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall
- quick commands: 
```
# check queue
curl -sS https://ingest.internal/health | jq .queue_depth
# restart worker
sudo systemctl restart redis-worker
```
- Priya pairing: 09:15 onboarding + 09:45 shadowing of incident triage

jess: got it. i'll DM Priya and confirm. tagging @maria for kernel notif too.

maria: 👍 will post infra note and include pager after 21:00 if anything changes.

oncall-bot: handoff note saved to thread 1919994321 by alex.

alex: leaving the doc here: https://docs.redwood/sprint/hand-offs/1919994321

jess: see you — will update `#eng-oncall` if anything pops. :coffee:

samir: added replica note to runbook. Good luck Priya!

priya: (DM to jess) thanks — excited to shadow, I'll be online at 09:00 Sat.

alex: thanks everyone, appreciate it.
